title: Auto-Activate Isotonic Calibration from HF Space OOB Predictions

problem.description: calibration/isotonic_breakpoints.json is an IDENTITY STUB (identity=true). The IsotonicPostCalibrator class is fully implemented with fit_and_export() and from_backtest() methods, but has never been called with real data. predict_today.py reads the stub and applies zero correction to all predictions. This leaves a known calibration gap unaddressed.
problem.evidence: isotonic_breakpoints.json metadata: {identity: true, fitted_on: null}. HF spaces have 9551 games of backtest data available. Research shows isotonic regression can reduce Brier by 50-70% on benchmarks; for our 0.22159 baseline, conservative estimate is 0.5-1% gain (~0.001-0.002 Brier points).
problem.impact: Every daily prediction uses uncalibrated raw model probabilities. Kelly sizing, ROI, and Sharpe all depend on well-calibrated probs.

proposed_solution.approach: Add /api/fit-calibration endpoint to hf-space/app.py (S10) that: (1) pulls the best model's OOB/holdout predictions from its internal training loop, (2) fits isotonic regression on those (raw_prob, outcome) pairs, (3) returns JSON breakpoints. VM calls this endpoint monthly and commits updated isotonic_breakpoints.json.
implementation_steps: 1. hf-space/app.py: add POST /api/fit-calibration endpoint. Uses best_model.predict_proba() on holdout split stored in evolution state.
2. returns JSON: {x_points: [...], y_points: [...], metadata: {n_samples, fitted_gen, fitted_at, brier_before, brier_after}}
3. scripts/fit-calibration.sh: curl -X POST https://nomos42-nba-quant.hf.space/api/fit-calibration → saves to calibration/isotonic_breakpoints.json → git commit + push
proposed_solution.fallback: If HF endpoint not available, from_backtest() queries Supabase nba_predictions table. Activate with: python3 -c "from calibration.isotonic_calibrator import IsotonicPostCalibrator; IsotonicPostCalibrator.from_backtest(Path('calibration/isotonic_breakpoints.json'))" — run on any machine with sklearn.

research_basis: Isotonic regression: Brier 0.1775→0.0518 (benchmark) — better than Platt for tree models
MDPI 2078-2489/17/1/56: Uncertainty-aware NBA with calibrated probs outperforms uncalibrated by ~8% AUC
sklearn 1.8: CalibratedClassifierCV with cv='prefit' is safe for post-hoc calibration on independent holdout
arxiv 2308.01222: Survey confirms isotonic best for tree-based models with sufficient samples (>500)

rollout_plan.step1: D2 Engineer adds /api/fit-calibration to hf-space/app.py — 30 min
rollout_plan.step2: Test on S10: curl POST, validate returned breakpoints are non-identity
rollout_plan.step3: Save breakpoints, re-run predict_today.py, measure Brier delta on recent games
rollout_plan.step4: If Brier improves: add monthly cron. If no improvement: investigate OOB sample quality.

related_proposals: calibration-brier-loss-2026-03-30.json — Brier loss as training objective
notes: This proposal activates EXISTING code (isotonic_calibrator.py already written, tested). No new ML technique — pure activation of dormant infrastructure. Highest ROI engineering task available right now.
